dialogue_texts: You won't be saved from extermination, Veronica.
I'm now laughing at you, pathetic humanoid shrine maiden.
Honestly, you all look the same to me when you're causing trouble.
You defeated my twin sister without even guessing the truth!
Please, I barely have time to keep the shrine clean, let alone deal with the Order.
Now that I'm mad because you freed my princess...
Both you and Fusana will be cursed to serve the Order and me!
Just hand over whatever is causing this night to persist.
I will give you a special reward for defeating my twin sister, and you will love it.
I don't need a reward. If you want revenge so badly, then come at me with everything you've got!
My dear, sweet, beautiful sister will be avenged!
